scope: Synthetic YouTube-shaped pages; real unpacked MV3 production build. Not live-platform selector validation.

checks.name: MV3 permissions and production package boundaries
real extension worker, popup and default YouTube controller
local reveal restores original display and SPA/reload reset reveal
popup settings propagate to multiple content tabs and restore
local account hide and popup unhide are serialized and reversible
hidden-item messages and popup review reveal current page only
content edits and appended replies trigger isolated rescans
settings export, preview, cancellation and explicit merge import
local advisory pack import is strict, escaped, opt-in and never hides benign content
MV3 worker restart retains authoritative settings and resumes writes
popup controls have labels and enable toggle supports keyboard use
unconsented optional site has no injected controller
1400-item feed completes in batches and stays quiet while idle
synthetic release screenshots and reversible demo use production UI
optional-site pending consent; headed grant and revocation path
